products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute (TII), a government laboratory founded in 2020 and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council, develops open-source generative AI models. The institute describes its work as making "Advanced AI accessible and Available to Everyone, Everywhere" and positions its models as tools to "advance applications and use cases to future-proof our world."

TII's primary product is the Falcon family of large language models, released under Apache 2.0 licensing for both research and commercial use. The lineup includes Falcon 180B, trained on 3.5 trillion tokens and currently ranked at the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for pre-trained open large language models; Falcon 40B, trained on one trillion tokens; Falcon 10B; and the newer Falcon 2 11B series, which the institute reports as open-source, multilingual, and multimodal with vision-to-language capabilities. Additional variants include Falcon-H1 and Falcon-E, which use hybrid Transformer and Mamba architecture, Falcon Arabic for Modern Standard Arabic and dialects, Falcon Mamba 7B as an open-source State Space Language Model, and Falcon Perception, a multimodal model combining vision and language capabilities. TII also established the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to advancing open-source generative AI development and building sustainable ecosystems around open-source projects.
